WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-89.688025 39.764682)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] < 500 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH pub_location AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-89.688025, 39.764682), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
lower_area AS (
  SELECT (rast).geom AS rast_geom
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    ST_Buffer(pub_location.geom, 100000, 'quad_segs=8'), -- buffer to cover search area
    ST_Transform(rast, 4326)
  ),
  (ST_Value(rast, 1) < 500)
),
nearest_point AS (
  SELECT ST_ClosestPoint(pub_location.geom::geometry, ST_Centroid(rast_geom)) AS nearest_point_geom
  FROM lower_area
  ORDER BY ST_Distance(pub_location.geom::geometry, ST_Centroid(rast_geom))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ST_Distance(pub_location.geom, nearest_point_geom::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM pub_location, nearest_point;
